Class SimpleDeterministicAbstractions.IntAbstractionImpl<S,A extends SimpleDeterministicAutomaton<S,?>>

java.lang.Object

public static class SimpleDeterministicAbstractions.IntAbstractionImpl<S,A extends SimpleDeterministicAutomaton<S,?>> extends Object implements SimpleDeterministicAbstractions.IntAbstraction
Base class implementing the default way of obtaining an integer abstraction from an automaton, i.e., by mapping states to integers and vice versa using the StateIDs mapping obtained via SimpleAutomaton.stateIDs().
